title: Hand FX
description: Hand tracking and layered WebGL2 effects for the stream: fireball on an open palm, lightning between arched fingertips, plus spark ring, ember rise and smoke veil. Tracking runs in the page; the server only owns what the operator sets and the command bus.

skins.label: Projectile skins (effect id → 'projectile' | 'heart')
skins.help: Optional, per effect. Only 'shoot' wears a skin today; absent means the default projectile orb. Written by the pane's skin switch and by projectile.fire {skin}.

enabled.label: Effects on (a page that loads with this off runs, but draws nothing until enabled)

mirror.label: Mirror the picture (selfie view — the default for a camera pointed at the operator)

obsHandFx.label: Draw effects in the OBS source (the pane preview follows the same flag)
obsHandFx.help: Off: the overlay page still tracks hands and reports gestures, but draws no effects, and the pane preview draws none either. Read by the overlay's frame loop and by the pane.

publish.label: Publish a second camera: off | raw | effects
publish.help: Feeds the 'ShockBox Virtual Camera' slot in WebcamSwitcher. raw sends the camera picture, effects sends the camera with the effects burned in; both are written to the frame pipe at the size format.ini advertises (1280x720 NV12 by default) and only while the overlay page is open. off opens no pipe and converts nothing, which leaves that camera slot black.

sensitivity.label: Tracking sensitivity
sensitivity.help: Scales detection/tracking confidence: higher finds hands in dim or partial view and fires gestures sooner, with more false positives.

deviceId.label: Camera device id (empty = first camera)
deviceId.help: Device ids are shown per browser origin; copy one from the pane's device list.

debugOverlay.label: Draw camera + landmarks on the overlay page
debugOverlay.help: On: the camera picture and the 21 landmarks are drawn under the effects (setup). Off: effects only.

effects.label: Effect order (enabled effects, in cycling order)
effects.help: Ids from the effect registry. An empty list is allowed: nothing is drawn.

intensity.label: Per-effect intensity
intensity.help: Per-effect multipliers (0–2), merged onto the defaults. Keys the pane knows: the registry's effect ids.

nextGesture.label: ‘Next effect’ gesture
nextGesture.help: The same two-hand gesture as lightning would race it, so the next-effect gesture must differ: touch two index fingertips to step the effect list.

bufferScroll.label: Effect travel from the bottom edge
bufferScroll.help: How far upward an effect rises from a palm near the bottom of the frame, in field heights.
